description: Vectors for the nightseam-grant/1 packet (docs/auth/grant.md). Keys are Ed25519 from the seeds shown; every byte is deterministic. Envelopes are Archon sdk envelopes sealed in the grant domain; digests are SHA-256 over whole envelope bytes. now is seconds since the Unix epoch, UTC, or null for no trusted time.
